source_url.description: Original download or reference URL for the dataset

source_organization.description: Organization, author, or research group publishing the dataset

license.description: License identifier or terms governing dataset usage (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0)

download_date.description: ISO-8601 timestamp or date when dataset was downloaded

original_file_name.description: Original filename of downloaded archive or document

original_size_bytes.description: Compressed size of the downloaded asset in bytes

checksum.description: SHA-256 or MD5 checksum hash of the downloaded asset

record_count.description: Total count of telemetry cases, records, or postmortems if known

data_types.description: Types of telemetry data present in dataset

cloud_provider.description: Target cloud environment (e.g. AWS, Multi-Cloud, Kubernetes)

services.description: AWS or cloud service categories covered

provenance.description: Detailed lineage and acquisition history of dataset

processing_status.description: Current lifecycle status of dataset processing

notes.description: Additional context or notes regarding usage constraints
